product: Custom AI accelerators (XPUs) plus AI networking, Ethernet switches, optics and serdes for hyperscalers Meta, Google, OpenAI, Anthropic (Reuters 2026-09-02). Broadcom IR (2026-09-02): Q3 AI semiconductor revenue $16.7B with XPUs the majority; infrastructure software (VMware) added $8.752B, up 29% YoY.
demand: Volume and mix, not price. AI semiconductor revenue rose 221% YoY to $16.7B on ramping XPU units and networking content (Broadcom IR 2026-09-02). Total revenue rose 86% YoY while non-GAAP operating margin held near 66% and Q4 is guided flat at about 66%, consistent with unit growth rather than pricing power.
pricing_power: Mix. Custom XPUs carry lower gross margin than infrastructure software, so faster XPU shift dilutes margin; Broadcom held non-GAAP operating margin near 66% for Q4, flat YoY, despite AI surging (Broadcom IR 2026-09-02). HBM and advanced-packaging cost inflation, or hyperscaler price pressure, would compress it further. Customer concentration amplifies the risk.
competition: No close Chinese substitute for Broadcom leading-edge custom XPUs and Ethernet; export controls keep Huawei Ascend and Cambricon out of US hyperscaler racks. The real substitutes are customer in-house designs and rivals Marvell or MediaTek; Reuters (2026-09-02) flags a Marvell custom-chip deal with Google. For VMware software, cheaper open-source virtualization is the substitute.

web_bottleneck: Broadcom constraint is manufacturing supply, leading-edge foundry and advanced packaging plus HBM. Tan said supply is secured for the higher FY2027 forecast (Reuters 2026-09-02). The bottleneck it relieves: hyperscaler shortage of cost-efficient, workload-specific compute and Ethernet scale-out that is not Nvidia-only.
web_who_benefits_next: Second order: AI spending broadening beyond Nvidia benefits custom-silicon and networking suppliers (Reuters 2026-09-02). Third order, from the same XPU, optics and switch ramp Broadcom describes (Broadcom IR 2026-09-02; @Broadcom 2026-09-19 on switch bandwidth and radix): the foundry, HBM, optics, substrate and data-centre power supply chains behind those sockets. Inference, not company guidance.
web_who_loses: Nvidia loses accelerator and InfiniBand sockets if custom XPUs plus Ethernet win; Marvell and MediaTek lose custom-ASIC share (Reuters 2026-09-02 cites the Marvell custom-chip deal with Google as competitive pressure). Legacy appliance and virtualization vendors displaced by VMware also lose. Broadcom itself has lagged, up about 6% in 2026 (Reuters 2026-09-02).

web_did_they_deliver: Yes on Q3. Reported 2026-09-02: revenue $29.591B beat the $29.36B estimate and non-GAAP EPS $3.32 beat $3.24 (Reuters 2026-09-02); AI semis $16.7B up 221% YoY; free cash flow $13.665B, 46% of revenue (Broadcom IR 2026-09-02). But the forward Q4 guide of $34.8B landed below the $35.03B consensus, a light guide.
